parameters.name: Bandwidth
parameters.description:
The maximum bandwidth of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance. Unit: Mbit/s.

Valid values: **1** to **1000**.

parameters.name: BandwidthPackageId
parameters.description: The ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc modify-common-bandwidth-package-spec --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --bandwidth-package-id cbwp-2ze2ic1xd2qeqk1450000 --bandwidth 1000 --region cn-hangzhou
